{{short description|Finnish cross-country skier}} {{Infobox skier | name = Juha Lallukka | image = | image_size = | alt = | caption = | nationality = {{FIN}} | full_name = | birth_name = | birth_date = {{birth date and age|1979|10|27|df=y}} | birth_place = [[Kouvola]], Finland | death_date = | death_place = | height = | club = Kouvolan Hiihtoseura | spouse = | seasons =10 – ([[2001–02 FIS Cross-Country World Cup|2002]]–[[2010–11 FIS Cross-Country World Cup|2011]]) | wins = 0 | teamwins = | totalpodiums = 1 | teampodiums = 0 | individual_starts = 22 | team_starts = 5 | wcoveralls = 0 – (57th in [[2004–05 FIS Cross-Country World Cup|2005]]) | wctitles = 0 }} '''Juha Lallukka''' (born 27 October 1979 in [[Kouvola]]) is a [[Finland|Finnish]] [[cross-country skiing (sport)|cross-country skier]] who competed between 2002 and 2018. He finished 34th in the 15 km event at the [[2010 Winter Olympics]] in [[Vancouver, British Columbia]], Canada. Lallukka's best finish at the [[FIS Nordic World Ski Championships]], was fourth in the 4 × 10 km relay in [[Oslo]] in [[FIS Nordic World Ski Championships 2011|2011]] while, his best individual finish was eighth in the 50 km event at the same championships. His best World Cup result was a third-fastest stage time in the 15 km pursuit race in [[Falun]] in 2009. On 16 November 2011, it was reported that he had tested positive for [[HGH]].{{cite web| url = http://www.hs.fi/english/article/Lallukka+denies+having+used+growth+hormone/1135269872825| url-status = dead| archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20111119231238/http://www.hs.fi/english/article/Lallukka+denies+having+used+growth+hormone/1135269872825| archive-date = 2011-11-19| title = Helsingin Sanomat - International Edition - Sport}} He was banned for two years.[https://sports.yahoo.com/news/wada-says-hgh-test-validated-skiers-ban-175216114--spt.html WADA says HGH test validated by skier's ban sports.yahoo.com 28 November 2014] ==Cross-country skiing results== All results are sourced from the [[International Ski Federation|International Ski Federation (FIS)]].{{cite web |url=https://data.fis-ski.com/dynamic/athlete-biography.html?sector=CC&competitorid=33602&type=result |title=Athlete : Juha LALLUKKA |author= |website=FIS-Ski |publisher=International Ski Federation |access-date=12 April 2019}} ===Olympic Games=== {| class="wikitable" style="font-size:95%; text-align:center; border:grey solid 1px; border-collapse:collapse; background:#ffffff;" ! style="background-color:#369; color:white; width:60px;"| Year  ! style="background-color:#369; color:white; width:40px;"| Age  ! style="background-color:#4180be; color:white; width:75px;"|  15 km
